result: For an inbound decoded request in generic serve_inner, the only pre-dispatch role hook is R::enforce_peer_request_association. The default ServiceRole implementation returns Ok(()), and RoleServer does not override that receive-side hook. serve_inner then moves RequestMetaObject into RequestContext and calls Service::handle_request without comparing or normalizing request-meta protocolVersion/clientCapabilities against peer_info. RequestContext<RoleServer> reads request-scoped protocolVersion first and, when request metadata is required, reads client_info/client_capabilities from request meta rather than handshake fallback. Therefore this exact post-initialize dispatch path contains no observed peer_info consistency/equality gate for those request-meta fields. This does not prove that every syntactically valid differing value reaches serve_inner: transport decode, RequestMetaObject structural validation, or individual handlers may still reject values elsewhere.
